---
description: "Template for a prospective RPIR implementation report"
---

# Implementation report: <short title>

Use prospectively; do not rewrite historical reports. This report is evidence, not scope, approval or acceptance.

## Delivered outcome and progress

- **Approved outcome:** `<inspected original Plan identity/version, explicit /implement invocation, original criteria and material boundaries; for correction include linked Review context>`.
- **Actual files and behavior:** `<changed files, delivered principal artifact with existence/content evidence; None if absent and explain why>`.
- **Completed Plan work:** `<IDs or outcomes; None if applicable>`.
- **Remaining Plan work:** `<IDs or outcomes and reasons; None if applicable>`. A partial report is a checkpoint, not completion.
- **Plan marker tracking:** `<checked Steps/Tasks and Work Items with supporting outcomes/gate evidence; where ordered evidence exists, distinguish completion-to-save/readback before unrelated later work, observed late reconciliation, and unverified timing; record remaining/reopened markers and reasons; disclose affected IDs with denied/failed/conflicting/unverified saves as unsaved tracking, distinct from delivered work>`.
- **Corrections:** `<failure diagnosis, attributable repair without overwriting user work, relevant recheck and result; None if not needed>`.
- **Architectural choice coverage and ADR evidence:** `<assess complete architectural choice coverage against Research, the approved Plan and actual changes, including missing or partial coverage even when a valid ADR is bound; reconcile each choice to inspected ADR identity/section/version/state, actual agreement/conditions and affected Work Items, or an explicit gap and resolution route. For unexpected uncovered or changed architecture, record engineer-directed Plan resolution before dependent architectural effects; continue independent approved work. Routine naming, helper extraction and architecture-preserving repairs remain Implement-owned without ADR reference; resolve material classification ambiguity with the engineer using evidence. Give an evidence-supported routine-only disposition if no architecture is identified, not None merely because no ADR is bound. Preserve exact binding and report material mismatch/unavailable content/unsatisfied conditions without floating versions, invented approval or Implement ADR authorship>`.

## Validation

- **Performed:** `<actual check and outcome; None if applicable>`.
- **Failed:** `<failed check, observed result and disposition; None if applicable>`.
- **Unavailable:** `<required check/capability unavailable, why and resulting gap; None if applicable>`.
- **Not run:** `<available check not attempted and why; None if applicable>`.
- **Limits and risks:** `<scope deviations, refused effects, residual risks and what static checks cannot prove>`.

## Execution and review evidence

- **Commands, if any:** `<actual permitted route, command/cwd, permission outcome, exit, sanitized output, observed generated/tracked/untracked and external effects, inspection limits; None if none>`. Execution is not validation.
- **Planned-versus-actual checkpoint accounting:** `<inspected approved Plan/version, explicit strategy/approval and required phase-invocation reference, or actual absence/prohibition without inferring authority; for each expected boundary identify Work Item/Task IDs, planned post-validation boundary, coherent content/purpose and strategy reference or planned justified exception, and actual disposition with evidence before unrelated work. Assess earlier coherent validated Task opportunities as well as every expected Work Item boundary, even with no commits. For combination/deferral/no-commit departures, state actual constraint/reason, affected IDs, validation/dependency consequence, later boundary if one exists and why the normal boundary was unsuitable. Flag missing/empty/generic or unexplained blanket exceptions as prospective planning defects while respecting actual prohibitions, including historical ones. No fabricated future obstacles or retrospective substantive approved-Plan exceptions; runtime obstacles are fresh implementation evidence. Distinguish timely handling, observed late/omitted handling and unverified chronology; final history/markers or silence do not prove timing. Preserve actual outcomes: not attempted, skipped—not applicable/no eligible changes, unavailable/unresolved, failed, no commit verified, verified (actual ID/parent/purpose/content/relevant validation), verified with unexpected effects, or completion uncertain with reconciliation needed. State covered scope and remaining uncommitted/local-only work; do not infer authority from silence/prohibition/unapproved options or success from exit status. No commit-count technical acceptance gate. If no boundary is applicable, explain with evidence rather than omit accounting. Separately granted phase-record effects name their bounded grant; unchanged Plan-covered effects need no duplicate grant.>`
- **Diff and preservation:** `<inspected changed work and principal artifact versus Plan; preservation of original criteria and unrelated work>`.
- **Independent review:** `<fresh Review needed, or reviewed findings and their resolution/uncertainty; no self-acceptance>`.

## Identity, direct lineage and next action

- **This report:** `<kind, subject/pass, inspected version and actual numbered physical location if saved>`.
- **Plan and predecessors:** `<inspected Plan identity/version and direct same-folder link to the real physical Plan; its Research lineage; for original-criteria correction link the inspected Review/report context, for material Review-origin Plan name its Review, prior report, previous Plan and Research>`.
- **Provenance:** `<original channel/locator; never manufacture a local path/link from a remote label>`.
- **Physical outcome:** `<actual containment and permission evidence, non-overwriting number selection/collision resolution and full readback of content/links; if save/readback failed say unfinished, not persisted>`. Preserve finalized records; optional status mirrors do not determine acceptance.
- **Next action:** `<manual /review with this inspected report version for independent assessment, or named material decision/unfinished delivery; never imply publication admits Review>`.

Include genuine open questions when they remain, with affected effects and evidence; do not manufacture a ceremonial question section.
